canonical_project: Somerville Technology, Industry & Business Park (potential data centre use)
owner: Procter Investments Pty Ltd / local landowners
notes: State-approved rezoning enables a ~37-50ha technology, industry and business park at 79/83 Bungower Road, Somerville (Mornington Peninsula Shire), described by proponents as a high-tech jobs hub with up to 50% green space; local press reports community fears of a future hyperscale data centre and a live planning application (P26/0263, 25 Bungower Road); NO confirmed data-centre operator, building or capacity exists - retained as a C-grade potential-use lead, not a datacentre project.
